Subject: AcmeHealth - Security & Data Residency follow-up

Hi Elena / Pablo,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items you flagged: 

1) SOC 2: You asked for our SOC 2 status. We completed SOC 2 Type II in July 2025. I've attached a redacted copy of the latest report for your review. If you need additional evidence (e.g., control narratives), Naomi can share those under an NDA.

2) GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood supports GDPR requirements and offers a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA). For HIPAA-covered workloads, we provide a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and have customers running PHI on Dedicated deployments.

3) Vendor Security Questionnaire: Attached is our completed vendor security questionnaire (PDF). If you prefer, we can fill out your RFP spreadsheet or a shared OneTrust questionnaire.

4) Data residency & export controls: We do have EU-region deployments (Frankfurt and Amsterdam regions). We can pin processing to EU-only for the data plane and provide SCCs where appropriate. On cross-border transfer and export controls, our security team follows sanctions screening and export-control guidance; ITAR-controlled data requires an approved plan. I'll loop Naomi for the technical specifics below.

Next steps:
- Naomi (cc'd) to confirm the SOC 2 attachments we can share and provide the EU-region deployment details (zones & data-at-rest location).
- Please confirm whether you'd like us to complete your vendor security spreadsheet or use the attached PDF.
- If helpful, let's schedule a 30-minute call next week with your security team — feel free to share availability.

Attaching: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_20270214.pdf (PDF, 312KB); SOC2_Report_2025-07_redacted.pdf (redacted)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Naomi and Rafael are cc'd; Naomi is our security & compliance lead and Rafael is supporting as the solutions engineer. Some quick answers while Naomi confirms the attachments and control contacts: 

- SOC 2: Attached redacted SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_Report_2025-07_redacted.pdf). Naomi — can you share control-owner contacts (for change management / access control) and confirm if we can provide a separate control narrative under NDA?

- EU region pinning: Yes — we support region-scoped deployments. For hosted customers we offer EU-only processing (data plane pinned to EU regions). Logs and platform metrics can be configured to remain within the EU for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted we provide an EU data residency option that keeps keys and logs in-region. We will surface the deployment architecture doc in the follow-up.

- Cross-border / export controls: We do not accept ITAR-controlled workloads without an approved compliance plan. We perform vendor/subcontractor due diligence and maintain OFAC screening procedures. Naomi — can you provide the standard statement we use for procurement teams?

- Questionnaire: Attached our vendor security questionnaire PDF as a starting point. If you share your spreadsheet, Rafael can ingest it and map responses.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync with our security team on Wed 2027-02-17 at 15:30 UTC. If that works for you I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (SOC 2 artifacts, EU deployment architecture, export-control statement).

Best,
Marissa

Hi Elena — copying the concise responses you requested. Happy to go deeper on the call.

1) SOC 2 artifacts: Attached is the redacted SOC 2 Type II report we are comfortable sharing publicly (SOC2_Report_2025-07_redacted.pdf). For deeper evidence (control owner contact, logs of access reviews, configuration baselines) we require a standard NDA / evidence exchange process. Contact for access-control owner: Lucas Meyer (lucas.meyer@redwoodinference.com). Change-control owner: Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com).

2) EU region & data residency: We support EU-only processing for Hosted customers via our eu-west and eu-central clusters (Frankfurt, Amsterdam). We can provide: 
- Deployment diagram showing where inference and storage live.
- Details on key management (customer-managed keys in KMS is available for Dedicated/Private).
- Logs & metrics: For Hosted with EU residency option, logs/metrics are configured to remain in region. If you require strict in-region-only telemetry for Hosted we recommend Dedicated or Private.

3) Cross-border transfer & export controls: 
- We use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for EU transfers and support customer-managed keying and region pinning to limit transfers.
- ITAR: Redwood does not process ITAR-controlled data by default. If an ITAR use-case emerges we will engage legal and limit processing to approved environments with export-control controls.
- OFAC/sanctions: We perform vendor and subcontractor screening, and our contractual terms require compliance with applicable export and sanctions laws. We can produce a signed procurement statement for your security/procurement team.

4) Questionnaire: We can complete your spreadsheet. Please share the file; Rafael will map answers to the attached PDF responses and return a completed copy.

I’ll be on the call on Wed 17th at 15:30 UTC. Agenda: 1) SOC 2 artifacts & evidence process, 2) EU deployment diagram & KMS options, 3) Export-control statement & procurement language.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
